content: Another OpenAI executive is departing. Denise Dresser, who joined OpenAI as its chief revenue officer in December after serving as CEO of Slack, will be leaving in the “coming weeks” to “pursue other opportunities,” she said in a team note posted to LinkedIn. Dali Rajic, president and COO of Wiz, will be taking over the CRO role, OpenAI says. Dresser’s departure is just the latest in a string of major exits. Earlier this week, special projects lead and former COO Brad Lightcap announced he would be leaving. (Dresser had taken over some of Lightcap’s work when he moved to the special projects role.) Former AGI chief Fidji Simo and former CMO Kate Rouch also recently stepped down. “We’re now at an inflection point: the next generation of models will change not just how work gets done but how companies are built and run,” OpenAI says. “Dali will build the revenue operating system needed to scale for this next phase.” Dresser is also leaving ahead of OpenAI’s IPO; the company announced in June that it had submitted a confidential S-1 filing to the Securities and Exchange Commission.

chineseContent: 另一位 OpenAI 高管即将离职。 Denise Dresser 在担任 Slack 首席执行官后于 12 月加入 OpenAI，担任首席营收官，她在 LinkedIn 上发布的一份团队说明中表示，她将在“未来几周”内离职，以“寻求其他机会”。 OpenAI 表示，Wiz 总裁兼首席运营官 Dali Rajic 将接任 CRO 职务。德莱瑟的离职只是一系列重大离职事件中最新的一个。本周早些时候，特别项目负责人兼前首席运营官 Brad Lightcap 宣布他将离职。 （当德莱塞调任特殊项目职位时，他接手了 Lightcap 的部分工作。）前 AGI 首席执行官 Fidji Simo 和前首席营销官 Kate Rouch 最近也辞职了。 OpenAI 表示：“我们现在正处于一个转折点：下一代模型不仅会改变工作的完成方式，还会改变公司的构建和运营方式。” “大理将构建下一阶段扩展所需的收入操作系统。” Dresser 也将在 OpenAI 首次公开募股之前离职；该公司于 6 月份宣布，已向美国证券交易委员会提交了一份保密的 S-1 备案文件。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
